QUOTE: "The only spawn in the index that touches shared state is the per-connection pthread server. It is a sample program, not library code. The library itself spawns nothing." and "The mutexes are global objects in `library/threading.c` with `MUTEX_INIT`"
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the library spawns no threads and that `library/threading.c` supplies the mutex layer, which many library modules use through `mbedtls_mutex_lock`.
